Phase 0 IMMEDIATE. ORACLE-6 is running on mock data only. Block A-01: download Space recordings from Voxight API, run Whisper base model locally, output timestamped transcripts to voxight-data/transcripts/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Batch mode, idempotent.

Project root: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight
Target file to CREATE: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/src/scripts/batch-transcribe.js
Read whisperLocal.js and twitterApi.js first for API signatures.
The script must: (1) query Supabase spaces table for all spaces with recording_url, (2) for each space call transcribeLocal(audioPath) from whisperLocal.js, (3) write JSONL output to /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/voxight-data/transcripts/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl, (4) be idempotent — skip spaces already in transcripts table. Use ES module syntax (import/export). Include a main() guard.
